opening.argument: The presentation leads with a rapid-return promise: “I have clearly shown how I make 4 bnb in 3 hours.” It provides a bot download link and password, directs viewers to paste a presale address into the bot, enter an investment and transaction parameters, and promises “maximum profit on the launch.” It further presents paid access as recoverable through a single trade, while reporting a claimed 3.5x result. The instructions to disable antivirus and Windows SmartScreen add a direct security concern. But the speaker also admits the software is still in testing and that a swap transaction failed. Those admissions mean the displayed performance is not independently established, even as the rapid-return, presale, download, and paid-access claims encourage viewers to rely on it.
